verdict.rationale: The published pages describe the bizfile online portal for filing, searching, and ordering records, but none of them document a guest, keyless, or file-number entry path for starting a filing without an account. The only access-related statements point the other way: web User Access is required for Statement of Information filings from August 1, 2026. Free viewing of document images is a records-search feature, not an account-free start to the core filing flow, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
